Two centrifugation steps are described for preparing the BA@HGNRs probe (Section 2.3, page 3):

1. **6800 rpm for 10 min.** The CTAB-stabilized HGNRs were centrifuged and then redispersed in an equal volume of KOH solution (pH 11).
2. **3600 rpm for 10 min.** After 320 μL of that solution was incubated with 6.4 μL of 4-MPBA (10 mM in ethanol) at 25 °C for 12 h with slow stirring (300 rpm) in the dark, the mixture was centrifuged again. It was then resuspended and concentrated in 160 μL of 10 mM NH₄HCO₃ to give the BA@HGNRs probe, which was stored at 4 °C.

The 300 rpm value is the stirring speed during incubation, not a centrifugation step.
